thread.title: Exclusive - Sen. Bernie Moreno Introduces Bill to Ban Foreign Flags on Capitol Grounds
thread.title_full: Exclusive - Sen. Bernie Moreno Introduces Bill to Ban Foreign Flags on Capitol Grounds

author: nanazona
text:
Moreno’s bill isn’t about patriotism—it’s about selective outrage. Republicans have no problem waving foreign flags when it suits their agenda. They proudly display the Israeli flag at rallies, wear Ukrainian flag pins in Congress, hoist Cuban flags in Miami, and celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with Irish flags. If foreign flags on U.S. soil were a real issue, the GOP would have banned them at AIPAC conferences or Reagan-era anti-communist rallies. But this isn’t about principle—it’s about punishing symbols they don’t like.
The same people who scream about free speech suddenly want to police what banners can be waved on public grounds. They weren’t demanding bans when Republicans proudly carried the South Vietnamese flag to protest communism or when they stood under Irish flags on Capitol Hill. This hypocrisy exposes their game: “free speech” is only free when it aligns with their worldview.
And let’s talk about what kind of governments actually ban foreign flags—authoritarian regimes, including historical communist states like the USSR and Maoist China, where nationalism was strictly controlled. If Moreno is worried about foreign influences, maybe he should focus on banning foreign money in politics instead of picking a fight over a piece of cloth. Or better yet, he could work on real issues—like protecting onions from tariffs that actually hurt Americans, rather than playing the culture war game with meaningless buzz topics of the day.
